messages:
sam_partners: quick sync 1: spun up a tiny repo `nimbus-iac-mini` for marketplace partners. goal: a minimal, copy-friendly terraform starter that validates in one region and documents how to produce a marketplace-ready image. https://github.com/redwood/nimbus-iac-mini
leah_cloud: thanks. suggest v0 includes: terraform module, a tiny sample service (python), a one-region CI smoke flow, and a short "how to package" note. skip full packaging for v0.
omar_infra: agree. limit the CI to a single cheap region (us-east-1) and small instance (t3.small) for the smoke so we don't burn credits. add backend example for s3 state with kms encryption.
tara_pm: product asks: add a dev vs prod sizing callout (one line each) and a two-sentence marketplace blurb we can hand to partner marketing.
sam_partners: will add README and the sizing callouts. plan two var files: `nimbus.demo.tfvars` and `nimbus.market.tfvars` with packaging off by default.
ryan_docs: i'll prepare the quickstart and a partner-review checklist. need a short screenshot flow for NimbusMarket listing later.
omar_infra: CI sketch (GH Actions) - keep it cheap and ephemeral:
```
name: smoke
on: [push]
jobs:
  smoke-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: terraform init
        run: terraform init
      - name: terraform apply
        run: terraform apply -auto-approve -var-file=nimbus.demo.tfvars
      - name: smoke curl
        run: |
          url=$(terraform output -raw service_url)
          curl -fsS "$url/health" || exit 1
      - name: destroy
        if: always()
        run: terraform destroy -auto-approve -var-file=nimbus.demo.tfvars
```
ci-bot: repository created: github.com/redwood/nimbus-iac-mini by sam_partners
leah_cloud: also include a tiny telemetry opt-in flag and a Prometheus /metrics endpoint in the sample service. label clearly as "opt-in telemetry" (no PII).
tara_pm: timeline: Nimbus partner wants a tech walkthrough in 3 weeks. internal review in 8 days would be great. can we do that?
omar_infra: 8 days ok if packaging is optional. i'll help land provider pinning and backend snippet.
ryan_docs: will draft quickstart + two-sentence marketplace blurb and attach to PR. will also include a short checklist: bake AMI, run smoke, verify metrics, publish manifest.
sam_partners: adding CONTRIBUTING.md and LICENSE (Apache-2.0). will open PR as soon as README + demo vars + sample app exist.
leah_cloud: recommend two example `instance_profile` variables: one dev (t3.small) and one prod (g5.xlarge) so partners see the delta.
omar_infra: please include a small rollback section in README: terraform destroy + contact partner-eng. makes cleanup obvious.
ryan_docs: making note to add "known limitations" section (regions, arm64 caveats) for partner review.
